rows.note: Use this everyday phrase when “ecologically” means in an environmentally friendly way; it is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.english: This restaurant handles food waste ecologically.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳用環保方法處理廚餘。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jung6 waan4 bou2 fong1 faat3 cyu2 lei5 cyu4 jyu4

rows.note: Use this more exact term when the manner specifically concerns ecology rather than practical environmental friendliness.

example.english: The report calls for this plan to be assessed ecologically.
example.traditional: 報告要求以生態方式評估呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 jiu1 kau4 ji5 sang1 taai3 fong1 sik1 ping4 gu2 nei1 go3 gai3 waak6
